<b>Runtfeast</b> is a [[Hunt Wishes|Hunt Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, an alternate version of <i>[[Broodfeast]]</i>, begun by talking to the [[Runt]] in the [[Putrified Ducts]] if <i>Broodfeast</i> was not completed by [[Act 3]].

Due to their Wish requirements being identical, any progress made in <i>Broodfeast</i> carries forward into <i>Runtfeast</i>.

== Wish ==
Runt requires various types of meat so they may feed and grow strong like their siblings. They ask [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to collect 3 types of organs for them by killing organic enemies in various ways. Almost every non-mechanical enemy in the game is compatible with this Wish.

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Huntress 01.png!Location of Runt in Putrified Ducts
}}
{{Gallery
| Image1 = Seared Organ.png!link=Seared Organ!15 Seared Organs
| Image2 = Shredded Organ.png!link=Shredded Organ!35 Shredded Organs
| Image3 = Skewered Organ.png!link=Skewered Organ!10 Skewered Organs
}}

15 [[Seared Organ]]s can be obtained by roasting enemies using fiery or electrical attacks:

* [[Needle]] after using [[Flintslate]]
* [[Pimpillo]]
* [[Wispfire Lantern]]
* [[Voltvessels]]
* Other sources of heat (i.e. a [[Memoria]] blown up by another Memoria's electrified explosive)

35 [[Shredded Organ]]s can be gathered by tearing up enemies using jagged weapons:

* [[Sawtooth Circlet]]
* [[Cogwork Wheel]]
* [[Delver's Drill]]
* [[Conchcutter]]
* [[Beast Crest]]'s downwards attack
* [[Architect Crest]]'s downwards and [[Needle Strike]] attacks

10 [[Skewered Organ]]s can be gathered by stabbing or impaling enemies with:

* [[Sting Shard]] 
* [[Longpin]]
* [[Needle Phial]]

== Reward ==
[[File:Longclaw.png|link=Longclaw|left|frameless|50px]]
Upon bringing all 60 organs to [[Runt]], they reward Hornet with the [[Longclaw]].

{{Clear}}

== Trivia ==
* Despite not dying or appearing seriously wounded, [[Pinstress]] with the appropriate damage will also drop the respective Organ if the Wish is active.
